title: Build Grave Accord and polish rooms, records, and the first run
head: feat/first-playable-loop
body:
Grave Accord is a cooperative bullet-hell game with seven classes, 66 executable boss identities, five modes and six maps. This draft keeps the feature branch separate from protected main while public polish continues.

Boss clears previously opened the next menu immediately, hiding the fall. They now leave two seconds for the existing fall or final pose with a top Boss defeated message and the boss name, then show the next choices or results. Fifteen bosses have full falling sequences; fifty-one have final poses. The beat preserves full voting time, does not add combat score time or repeat rewards, shares the server clock across peers and survives Solo/trusted room saves. Reduced motion uses a settled pose and static message.

New players get a gentle Solo preset, optional Tutorial, readable item names/prices, full home artwork, mode summaries and distinct difficulty icons. C opens and closes room chat; Enter starts typing. Chat has its own menu area, and upgrades scroll above a separate Start/Leave row. The player accepted those two chat/layout fixes. The obsolete rankings notice is removed. Solo pauses; online matches continue with the existing notice.

Team records use real authority counters and immutable SQLite results/participant history, with mode/difficulty/peak-size/week filters and paged team reads. Scores and competition ties are shared by the team. Departures retain credit, survival freezes before healing, base results bank before the optional extra fight, and Endless compares its last clear. Writes retry without stopping play; hosts can end Endless during breaks. Solo/test runs and client-submitted scores cannot enter the boards. Desktop LAN keeps its own records file.

Validation for source d10c9d378bfba98cab28875838636f4eecb17fee: full local gate and both exact-source CI jobs pass 787/787/0, authored content/fifteen locales/RGBA, TypeScript, production build and 71 atlas contracts. [CI 123465911565](https://github.com/ProgrammingWithYagle/Bullet-Hell-Game-Open-AI-Contest-/actions/runs/40879213322/job/123465911565) and [CI 123465815481](https://github.com/ProgrammingWithYagle/Bullet-Hell-Game-Open-AI-Contest-/actions/runs/40879185517/job/123465815481). Focused checks cover fall coverage, no repeat rewards, vote duration, save compatibility and real two-peer defeat timing. Both frozen audiences pass asset/source/transport checks without fake public scores. Wiki 887aff3948e3287292da2a961a86440d6de93b01 matches all 18 pages/34 images/public hashes. Complete logs and limits: reviews/boss-defeat-2026-10-29/.

The preceding a0c8c56 Windows review passes all three package copies and six native offline/LAN/storage fixtures, including long copied paths. It predates newer chat and boss-defeat changes. Older packages, previews and failed evidence remain preserved.

Team boards are scoped to the selected server. Shared deployed global rankings/recovery, WAN/endurance/capacity and current rendered/human/native-language/listening/device acceptance remain open. Boss-defeat pacing awaits human playtest. The older protocol-4 Site and immutable protocol-13 Windows download remain separately versioned. No main merge, hosted deployment or contest submission is included.
